title: elaphoglossum nivosum
intro: Elaphoglossum nivosum, commonly known as the Snowy Elaphoglossum, is a species of epiphytic fern native to Central and South America, characterized by its delicate, lacy fronds. The health benefits of Elaphoglossum nivosum include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat coughs and colds, as well as its potential to have sedative and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Elaphoglossum nivosum have been found to include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
